international_aviation.headline: 美國航空選定DO CO為希斯洛機場常態餐飲商
international_aviation.summary: 據 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空在經歷長達 5 個月的臨時替代方案後，已選定 DO & CO 擔任其於希斯洛機場的常態餐飲服務供應商。隨著新的長期合約生效，搭乘美國航空相關航班的旅客預期將能迎來機上餐單的全面恢復。
international_aviation.headline_en: American Airlines Names DO & CO as Permanent Heathrow Caterer
international_aviation.summary_en: According to aviation news reported by Simple Flying, American Airlines has selected DO & CO to serve as its permanent catering contractor at London Heathrow Airport, effectively ending a five-month transitional period during which the carrier relied on stopgap catering measures. As DO & CO officially takes over responsibility as the airline's permanent caterer at Heathrow, passengers traveling with American Airlines can expect a full restoration of the carrier's inflight menu offerings.

international_aviation.headline: 俄羅斯首架量產型MC-21-310客機完成首飛
international_aviation.summary: 俄羅斯首架量產型MC-21-310客機於2026年8月3日從位於西伯利亞伊爾庫茨克的聯合航空製造公司設施起飛，成功完成歷時1小時23分鐘的首飛。該機採用俄製PD-14發動機及國產零部件，飛行期間最高速度達每小時600公里，飛行高度達6000公尺。
international_aviation.headline_en: First Production Model of Russia's MC-21-310 Completes Maiden Flight
international_aviation.summary_en: Russia's first production MC-21-310 aircraft completed its maiden flight on August 3, 2026, taking off from United Aircraft Corporation's (UAC) facility in Irkutsk, Siberia. During the one-hour-and-23-minute initial test flight, the aircraft reached a maximum speed of 600 kilometers per hour and an altitude of 6,000 meters. The MC-21-310 is powered by Russian-made PD-14 engines and incorporates a higher proportion of domestic components. As of August 2026, the aircraft remains in its certification process, with UAC reporting 18 additional MC-21-310 aircraft in various stages of completion at the plant.

international_aviation.headline: 美國空軍結束戴維斯-蒙森基地A-10戰機近半世紀飛行任務
international_aviation.summary: 美國空軍於2026年7月29日完成A-10C攻擊機在亞利桑那州戴維斯-蒙森空軍基地的最後一次飛行，正式結束該機在該基地近五十年的飛行營運。作為A-10飛行員正式訓練單位的第357戰鬥機中隊已於4月畢業最後一期學員。空軍規劃將部分A-10服役期延長至2030年，戴維斯-蒙森基地將轉型接納特種作戰與救援單位。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Air Force Ends Five Decades of A-10 Flights at Davis-Monthan Base
international_aviation.summary_en: The United States Air Force completed its final A-10C Thunderbolt II sortie from Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Arizona on July 29, 2026, ending nearly five decades of A-10 flight operations at the location. The 357th Fighter Squadron, which served as the formal training unit for A-10 pilots, graduated its final class in April 2026. While the base shifts its mission toward hosting Air Force Special Operations Command units, official plans announced by Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink will extend the operational service of remaining A-10 squadrons at other bases through 2030.

international_aviation.headline: 日本航空攜手日立與商船三井 於沖繩久米島展開直接海洋碳捕捉測試
international_aviation.summary: 日本航空於2026年8月4日宣布，已與日立及商船三井簽署協議，將於沖繩縣久米島共同進行日本首個直接海洋碳捕捉技術的實證測試。該項目將利用設置於陸地上的貨櫃化設備抽取海水並分離二氧化碳。日本航空亦與區域夥伴日本越洋航空及琉球空中通勤合作推廣該計畫，並探索未來將捕捉到的二氧化碳作為製造永續航空燃料原料的可行性。
international_aviation.headline_en: Japan Airlines Partners with Hitachi and MOL for Ocean Carbon Capture Test on Kume Island
international_aviation.summary_en: Japan Airlines announced on August 4, 2026, that it has partnered with Hitachi and Mitsui O.S.K. Lines to conduct Japan's first pilot test of Direct Ocean Capture technology on Kume Island in Okinawa Prefecture. The project will deploy land-based containerized equipment to draw in seawater and remove dissolved carbon dioxide. Japan Airlines, alongside regional partners Japan Transocean Air and Ryukyu Air Commuter, will lead outreach efforts for the test and aims to explore utilizing the captured carbon dioxide as a raw material to produce sustainable aviation fuel in the long term.

international_aviation.headline: Simple Flying於范保羅航展導覽阿聯酋航空空中巴士A350客艙
international_aviation.summary: Simple Flying團隊於2026年范保羅航展期間，實地導覽阿聯酋航空全新空中巴士A350-900寬體客機。導覽涵蓋該航空公司全新的商務艙、擴大設置的豪華經濟艙、升級的ice機上娛樂系統，以及重新設計的經濟艙，展示各客艙配備與乘客搭乘體驗。
international_aviation.headline_en: Simple Flying Tours Emirates' New Airbus A350-900 at Farnborough Airshow 2026
international_aviation.summary_en: Tom and Alejandro of Simple Flying conducted a full tour of Emirates' brand-new Airbus A350-900 aircraft during the Farnborough Airshow 2026. Their walkthrough detailed the interior cabin features across all classes, including the airline's all-new Business Class, an expanded Premium Economy cabin, an upgraded ice inflight entertainment system, and a redesigned Economy Class. The tour provided a detailed overview of every cabin, highlighting the latest features and showing what passengers can expect when flying on the carrier's newest widebody aircraft.

sources.name: Simple Flying — What It's Like Inside Emirates' New Airbus A350-900

international_aviation.headline: 樟宜機場攜手SATS推出自主導航輪椅服務
international_aviation.summary: 根據 AeroTime 報導，樟宜機場集團與地勤夥伴 SATS 於 2026 年 8 月 4 日宣布推出自主導航輪椅，旨在提高行動不便旅客的便利性。該輪椅配備智慧導航與安全功能，預計全面推廣後可分擔約 10% 的日常行動協助需求，此前測試已有逾 1.3 萬名旅客使用。
international_aviation.headline_en: Changi Airport Rolls Out Autonomous Wheelchairs for Mobility-Impaired Travelers
international_aviation.summary_en: According to AeroTime, Changi Airport Group (CAG) and its ground handling partner SATS announced the rollout of autonomous wheelchairs at Singapore Changi Airport on August 4, 2026. The self-driving wheelchairs are designed to help passengers with reduced mobility navigate terminals independently, reducing the need for one-on-one staff assistance. The initiative, part of SATS' 'Hub Handler of the Future' project, is expected to eventually handle approximately 10% of Changi's daily mobility assistance demands. The technology underwent trials beginning in March 2025, serving over 13,000 passengers during the testing phase.
